name: Mitsu Schwarz Kattsue
original_name: 光・シュヴァルツカッツェ
source:
Mitsu is a new student and already has a poor reputation in the school. She is quite cold and dry with people talking to her.

She meets [url=https://vndb.org/c77251]Seiji[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c21955]Karin[/url] one day on the way to school, trying to get a little cat stuck in a tree but without success. When Seiji and Karin offer her help, she categorically refuses and tries to climb the tree to retrieve the little cat. However, she stumbles and falls on Seiji's head who wanted to catch her but... [spoiler]Her inner parties are found on the mouth of Seiji who made her an involuntary proto-cunnilingus that excit... angry and embarrassed her enormously.[/spoiler]

Nevertheless, thanks to Karin, the misunderstanding is quickly settled and the two girls and Seiji become friends. They will introduce her later to others so that she becomes their friend too.

[spoiler]Mitsu is a typical [url=https://vndb.org/i220]Coodere[/url]; she is in fact super adorable but she shows this trait of her personality only to the people she appreciates.

She doesn't have any confidence in herself, more than Karin. She thinks nothing is attractive in her and she hates her personality. This hatred she feels for herself even gives her the feeling that no one can feel love for her.

Sometimes she speaks German when she says "Guten Morgen" (Good Morning) or "Ja" (Yes) but speaks Japanese for more complex sentences. However, she speaks fully in German when she loses balance (emotionally speaking).

She comes from a very wealthy family but she doesn't boast about it at all and doesn't even show it.[/spoiler]
